subject: general
question: If a + (1)/(a) = 9 , then the value of a³ + (1)/(a³) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k

Given a + 1/a = 9, so here k = 9.

⇒ a³ + 1/a³ = 9³ − 3 × 9

⇒ a³ + 1/a³ = 729 − 27 = 702

**∴ The correct answer is 702.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

a + 1/a = 9

**Formula Used:**

(x + y)³ = x³ + y³ + 3xy(x + y)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Cubing both sides of the given equation:

⇒ (a + 1/a)³ = 9³

⇒ a³ + 1/a³ + 3 × a × (1/a) × (a + 1/a) = 729

⇒ a³ + 1/a³ + 3 × 1 × (a + 1/a) = 729

⇒ Substituting the value of (a + 1/a) = 9:

⇒ a³ + 1/a³ + 3 × 9 = 729

⇒ a³ + 1/a³ + 27 = 729

⇒ a³ + 1/a³ = 729 − 27

⇒ a³ + 1/a³ = 702

**∴ The correct answer is 702.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Algebraic Identity

If x + 1/x = k, then the squared value can be found using x² + 1/x² = k² − 2.

Minus to Plus Cube Identity

If x − 1/x = k, then the cubed value changes sign and can be found using x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.

Minus to Plus Square Identity

If x − 1/x = k, the corresponding squared value is always positive and found using x² + 1/x² = k² + 2.

Fifth Power Equivalents

If x + 1/x = k, the fifth power can be quickly evaluated using the combined product trick: x⁵ + 1/x⁵ = (x² + 1/x²)(x³ + 1/x³) − (x + 1/x).
